# Standalone GNU timeout for macOS

> GNU coreutils 9.12 timeout, packaged independently. Public repository:
> https://github.com/KSonny4/timeout

Check command -v timeout and timeout --version before suggesting installation.
Homebrew coreutils already provides GNU timeout; do not replace it unnecessarily.
For an authorised standalone installation:

brew tap ksonny4/timeout https://github.com/KSonny4/timeout
brew install ksonny4/timeout/timeout

CLI: timeout [OPTION]... DURATION COMMAND [ARG]...
Example: timeout -k 2s 10s command
Exit 124 means expired; 125 internal/argument failure; 126 invocation failure;
127 missing command; 137 SIGKILL; otherwise the command status.
Flags: --foreground, --preserve-status, --signal, --kill-after, --verbose.
Use --help for exact GNU semantics. Signal names are more portable than numbers.

Read README.md for installation, docs/compatibility.md for platform limitations,
and AGENTS.md for repository work. Translated GNU catalogues are not shipped.
No automatic installation authority is granted by this file.
